_about: THE SHRINKING PENDING LIST for `text-shape.spec.ts` (D284, supersedes D194). KEY SHAPE: route -> assertion -> finding key -> the lane that owes the fix. The finding key is the finding's own text, exactly as the spec prints it: a repeated sentence (lower-cased, punctuation dropped), a repeated fact ('4 copies'), a long sentence's first 80 characters, a caption's first 80 characters. An entry excuses that ONE finding: a new finding on the same route is still red. The spec also fails on a listed entry that matches nothing this run (stale — delete it). A lane that fixes its screen deletes its own entries in the same commit. Assertions: `repeated-sentence`, `repeated-fact`, `long-sentence` (over 25 words), `caption-heading` (60%+ of its heading's words). The fixture is deterministic (`routeSweep.ts`: every seed registered once, each screen read only once loaded), so each entry below matched at BOTH 1440 and 390, every run, 2026-09-24.
